name: 执行层-项目执行详情
description: 项目执行监控钻取页面，展示关键任务节点、资源负载及延期项目排行。

sqlConfig.query: WITH agg AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND d.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND d.is_due THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS due_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN d.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND d.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND d.is_on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_time_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN d.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND d.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND d.is_overdue_completed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_completed_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN d.actual_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND d.actual_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND d.is_completed AND (d.plan_year != d.actual_year OR d.plan_month != d.actual_month) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outside_completed_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN d.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND d.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND d.is_incomplete AND d.is_milestone_node THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS incomplete_milestone_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN d.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND d.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND d.is_milestone_node AND d.is_on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS milestone_on_time_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN d.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND d.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND d.is_milestone_node AND d.is_overdue_completed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS milestone_overdue_completed_cnt FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 d WHERE ((d.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND d.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM')) OR (d.actual_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND d.actual_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM'))) [[AND d.dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND d.project_no = {{projectNo}}]]) SELECT CASE WHEN (agg.due_cnt+agg.outside_completed_cnt)=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((agg.on_time_cnt+agg.overdue_completed_cnt+agg.outside_completed_cnt)::numeric/(agg.due_cnt+agg.outside_completed_cnt)::numeric*100,2) END AS "完成率", CASE WHEN (agg.incomplete_milestone_cnt+agg.milestone_on_time_cnt+agg.milestone_overdue_completed_cnt)=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((agg.milestone_on_time_cnt+agg.milestone_overdue_completed_cnt)::numeric/(agg.incomplete_milestone_cnt+agg.milestone_on_time_cnt+agg.milestone_overdue_completed_cnt)::numeric*100,2) END AS "里程碑完成率" FROM agg

SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_due THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_abnormal_pending AND NOT d.is_general_node THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)+SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_overdue_unchanged AND NOT d.is_general_node THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))::numeric/SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_due THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric*100,2) END AS "异常率" FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 d WHERE d.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND d.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND d.dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND d.project_no = {{projectNo}}]] [[AND d.risk_level = {{riskLevel}}]]

SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_incomplete THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_incomplete AND d.is_high_risk THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric/SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_incomplete THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric*100,2) END AS "风险预警指数" FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 d WHERE d.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND d.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND d.dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND d.project_no = {{projectNo}}]] [[AND d.risk_level = {{riskLevel}}]]

SELECT project_no AS "项目编号", subsystem AS "分系统", node_task AS "节点任务", node_type AS "节点类型", owner AS "负责人", dept AS "责任科室", completion_status AS "完成情况", risk_level AS "风险等级", plan_date AS "计划时间", actual_date AS "实际完成", delay_days AS "延期天数", incomplete_reason AS "未完成原因" FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 WHERE plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND project_no = {{projectNo}}]] [[AND risk_level = {{riskLevel}}]] ORDER BY delay_days DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT dept AS "责任科室", COUNT(*) AS "节点总数", SUM(CASE WHEN is_completed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "已完成", SUM(CASE WHEN is_incomplete THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "未完成" FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 WHERE plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND project_no = {{projectNo}}]] AND dept IS NOT NULL GROUP BY dept ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN is_incomplete THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC

SELECT project_no AS "项目编号", subsystem AS "分系统", node_task AS "节点任务", node_type AS "节点类型", owner AS "负责人", dept AS "责任科室", completion_status AS "完成情况", risk_level AS "风险等级", plan_date AS "计划时间", actual_date AS "实际完成", delay_days AS "延期天数", incomplete_reason AS "未完成原因" FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 WHERE plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND project_no = {{projectNo}}]] [[AND risk_level = {{riskLevel}}]] AND is_incomplete = true ORDER BY delay_days DESC NULLS LAST
